title: HireHappy
tagline: HireHappy | Unlocking Easy Hiring, we empower gig workers helping access to insurance unemployment and benefits that grow with them

prizes.title: Boost Your Startup with NEAR Horizon

description:
The traditional hiring process often involves uncertainty and risk, especially when it comes to payments. Employers worry about paying upfront without guaranteeing satisfactory results, while freelancers fear non-payment for completed work. This lack of trust and transparency can hinder productivity and lead to disputes.

HireHappy solves these challenges by implementing a robust escrow system multichain. Here's how it works: When an employer selects a freelancer for a project, they deposit the agreed-upon payment into our secure escrow account. The funds are held safely until the project is completed to the employer's satisfaction. 

Benefits:

Security: "Our escrow feature provides a layer of security for both employers and freelancers, mitigating the risk of non-payment or subpar work."
Transparency: "With HireHappy, all transactions are transparent, and both parties can track the status of payments in real-time."
Confidence: "By offering a secure payment mechanism, HireHappy instills confidence in employers and freelancers, fostering long-term relationships and repeat business."
how_its_made: We developed a smart contract that simplifies the creation of escrows, allowing to receive payments with any ERC20 token. Our application is multichain, deployed in several networks. On the backend, we use Solidity and Hardhat, while on the frontend we opted for Next.js for a smooth user experience. This combination ensures security and efficiency, facilitating secure transactions.
